stories.title: InvestigateTV+: Banning nitrous oxide retail sales
stories.summary: A fight to ban recreational use of nitrous oxide heads to the nation’s capital.

stories.title: This symphony chorus is helping singers stay sharp
stories.summary: Research shows learning new things in a social setting, along with proper nutrition, sleep, and exercise can reduce the risk of Alzheimer’s disease by 60%.

stories.title: Could drones help transport organs? Here’s how it might work
stories.summary: Mid-America Transplant is now using drones to transport donor blood samples, which will cut down the time it takes to identify and confirm donors.

stories.title: Here’s who’s eligible for money in the $32 million class-action GoodRx settlement
stories.summary: GoodRx has agreed to a $32 million settlement in a class-action lawsuit that alleged the company disclosed customers’ personal and health information.

stories.title: ‘Pure anger’: Therapist fired over video that appears to show her hit 7-year-old with autism
stories.summary: A therapist who works with children on the autism spectrum has been fired over a video that appears to show her hitting a 7-year-old client.

stories.title: Kapiolani Community College food pantry fills more than plates
stories.summary: Kapiolani Community College helps students and neighbors access nutritious food while faculty support first-year students on their own journey through college.

stories.title: Maui police commission votes to keep chief on paid administrative leave
stories.summary: The Maui Police Commission voted 6-1 to keep Chief John Pelletier on paid leave. His attorney says he expects to file a lawsuit seeking reinstatement next week.

stories.title: Chinatown cafe and bar Manifest announces closure
stories.summary: Manifest, located on Hotel Street, announced Thursday, Nov. 19, will be its last day of service.

stories.title: Woman crashes into wall at Waikiki hotel parking lot
stories.summary: A woman crashed into a wall at a Waikiki hotel parking lot. A witness said firefighters helped her out of the car, but the extent of her injuries was not immediately clear.

stories.title: Kona cheer team advances to national competition in North Carolina
stories.summary: A Kona cheer team is headed to nationals in North Carolina after placing first at regionals. The team is working to raise $28,000 for the trip.

stories.title: Rainbow Wahine open final road trip against UTEP in El Paso
stories.summary: The Rainbow Wahine swept UTEP in El Paso and will face the Miners again Thursday in their regular-season finale.

stories.title: Agenda item leads Honolulu police commissioner to resign as chair
stories.summary: The sudden and unexpected resignation left many confused over the path forward.
